question: Who among the following won the Global Teacher Prize awarded in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mansour Al Mansour**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mansour Al Mansour** won the **Global Teacher Prize**, which is an annual award recognizing exceptional teachers around the globe who have made outstanding contributions to their profession.
 
• The award was established by the **Varkey Foundation** to elevate the status of teaching and highlight the critical role teachers play in shaping the future.
 
• In the year **2025**, Mansour Al Mansour was honored for his innovative teaching methods and his contributions to improving education accessibility in underprivileged areas.
 
• The **Global Teacher Prize** carries a substantial monetary reward of **$1 million** and is recognized as one of the most prestigious awards in the field of education.
 
• Mansour's work primarily focused on integrating **technology in education**, fostering **inclusive learning environments**, and addressing the challenges of marginalized communities in his region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Global Teacher Prize:**

 
 
• Launched in **2014** by the **Varkey Foundation**, the prize aims to celebrate the best educators worldwide.
 
• It recognizes teachers who have gone beyond traditional teaching practices to inspire students and create a lasting impact on their lives and communities.
 
• The prize is open to teachers from all countries and levels of schooling, from kindergarten through high school.
 
 
 
• **Varkey Foundation:**
 
 
• The Varkey Foundation is a global charitable organization dedicated to improving the quality of education for children around the world.
 
• It was founded by **Sunny Varkey**, an education entrepreneur and philanthropist.
 
• The foundation focuses on empowering teachers, enhancing educational opportunities, and addressing global education challenges.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Education Accessibility:**
 
 
• Education accessibility ensures that individuals from all socio-economic backgrounds can access quality education.
 
• It plays a critical role in reducing inequalities and promoting social mobility.
 
• Integrating technology, as Mansour Al Mansour demonstrated, can bridge gaps in educational infrastructure and resources.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Winners:**
 
 
• In **2020**, **Ranjitsinh Disale** from India won the prize for his work in promoting girls' education and using QR codes in textbooks.
 
• Sister Zeph, a nominee in earlier years, gained recognition for her efforts in educating girls in rural Pakistan.
 
• Asma Mustafa, another notable educator, has contributed significantly to refugee education in conflict zones.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Eligibility for Global Teacher Prize:**

 
 
• Open to all working teachers who teach children between the ages of 5 and 18 or provide education to students in a formal school setting.
 
• Applicants are evaluated based on their achievements, innovative teaching practices, and impact on their communities.
 
 
 
• **Prize Significance:**
 
 
• The $1 million award is meant to highlight the importance of teachers and their contribution to society.
 
• Winners often use the prize money to further their educational projects and benefit their communities.
 
 
 
• **Future Implications:**
 
 
• Recognizing teachers through such awards encourages more individuals to pursue teaching as a career.
 
• It fosters global discussions on the value of education and the need for systemic improvements in teaching methodologies.
